text:
incident-bot: PAGER — High GPU pool saturation detected in us-west-2 (hotpath). 429 spike on hosted API, queue growth on hotpath pools. Paging oncall.

alice (oncall): ack, grabbing pager. any customer reports yet?

erin (support): multiple tickets coming in for 429s and timeouts, some from integrations. Not an SLO breach yet but trending bad.

bob (eng-sre): quick metrics snapshot: hotpath_pool_gpu_util=98% , queue_depth~=12,300, 95th latency up to 1.8s, 429_rate=11.6%. Token-bucket drop rate increasing. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/Hotpath/queue?panelId=3

carmen (eng-runtime): autoscaler logs show repeated failures to scale: "scale_loop: scale_limit_reached pool=hotpath-usw2 max_instances=40". It never kicks past 40 even under sustained queue growth.

dex (eng-platform): confirmed — pool max was set to 40 by policy change last week (PR #487). Also noticing tier routing rules pushed a lot of low-priority realtime requests to hotpath due to rule precedence bug.

alice (oncall): can we temporarily increase the pool max and throttle non-critical traffic off hotpath?

carmen (eng-runtime): we can bump to 60 quickly via infra API:
```
infra-cli pools update --name hotpath-usw2 --max-instances 60
```
need eng-sre + oncall ack before changing (cost/capacity implications).

bob (eng-sre): ack to bump to 60. also we should adjust token-bucket refill for prod tiers — current refill looks 0.6x of intended due to a deploy bug. increase refill for prod-high to reduce drops for steady customers.

alice (oncall): go ahead, carmen escalate pool bump, bob tune rate config. erin prepare customer comms template.

carmen (eng-runtime): applying pool bump now. posting infra events.

(2m later)

carmen (eng-runtime): infra-cli -> OK: updated hotpath-usw2 max_instances=60. Scaling events queued, autoscaler sees targets.

bob (eng-sre): patching tokenbucket config for tier prod-high:
```
PATCH /config/tier/prod-high
{ "token_refill_per_sec": 1500 }
```
applied. rolling config to edge routers.

(3m)

alice (oncall): observed: queue_depth dropping 12.3k -> 3.4k, 429_rate 11.6% -> 2.1%, 95th latency trending down.

erin (support): customer tickets updated — most report improvement, a couple still on edge. sending status template now.

frank (product): note — we routed some beta/canary traffic to hotpath yesterday for latency tests. any chance that contributed?

dex (eng-platform): yes, beta traffic was mistakenly prioritized to hotpath by a routing precedence rule (PR #492). I'm rerouting beta to dedicated-beta pool now.

(1m)
dex (eng-platform): reroute completed. beta -> dedicated-beta. no more extra load on hotpath from canary.

bob (eng-sre): root-cause summary so far: 1) autoscaler hit configured hard cap (max_instances=40) and refused to burst; 2) tier routing bug sent unexpected low-priority load to hotpath; 3) tokenbucket refill deploy bug reduced effective refill rates, exacerbating 429s.

gita (customer-success): I'll call top 5 affected accounts, coordinate credits and follow-up.

alice (oncall): oncall handoff in 25m. I'll escalate follow-ups: eng-platform to fix routing precedence, eng-runtime to add autoscaler emergency-burst behavior, eng-sre to add config validation for tokenbucket deploys. Create postmortem and runbook updates.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated / monitoring. Will close pager if no alerts in 15m.

(reacted :white_check_mark: by alice (oncall), bob (eng-sre))
